review_evidence: Reviewed the 1,920-file pinned snapshot and rocq-of-rust workflow/documentation plus representative Rocq sources.

The project translates Rust THIR into Rocq, performs linking and simulation, and supplies formal specifications/proofs; generated translations are themselves formal semantic models and interfaces relevant to prior-art search.
No broad generated-file exclusion is lossless under the corpus inclusion policy, so all 1,910 primary Rocq files remain searchable.
summary: Retain rocq-of-rust in full as formal semantics, translated program models, specifications, and verification infrastructure for Rust.

review_evidence: Surveyed the checkout root (`find . -maxdepth 1`): only `RocqOfRust/` and `ink/` hold source content; `Cargo.toml`, `run_tests.py`, `.gitmodules`, `logo.png`, `rust-toolchain`, `Cargo.lock`, `clippy.toml`, `README.md`, `AGENT.md` are non-`.v` project metadata outside this unit's 41-file review scope.

Ran a Rocq declaration-marker grep (Definition|Theorem|Lemma|Fixpoint|Inductive|Record|Class|Instance|Module|Notation|Axiom|CoInductive|CoFixpoint) across all 41 files: scores ranged from 1 (two files: `instructions/tests/bitwise.v`, `instructions/tests/memory.v`) to 130 (`tests/interpreter_types.v`).

Read `instructions/tests/memory.v` in full (4737 bytes, 1 hit): 13 `Require Import` lines pulling in translated MCOPY/MLOAD/MSIZE/MSTORE/MSTORE8 opcode-simulation modules, one helper `Definition make_interpreter_with_memory`, and five `(** ... *)`-commented `Goal ... Proof. timeout 1 vm_compute. reflexivity.` (or `repeat split; reflexivity.`) `Qed.` blocks computationally verifying each opcode's effect on interpreter memory/stack state against the translated model -- genuine verification content; the marker grep undercounts because the file's real content is expressed as `Goal`/`Proof`/`Qed`/`vm_compute`, not `Theorem`/`Lemma`.

Read the head (40 lines) and tail (20 lines) of `instructions/tests/bitwise.v` (20664 bytes, 1 hit): 20 `Require Import` lines for LT/GT/CLZ/EQ/SLT/SGT/BITAND/BITOR/BITXOR/ISZERO/NOT/BYTE/SHL/SHR/SAR opcode-simulation modules, one helper `Definition make_interpreter_osaka`, followed by the same `Goal`/`Proof. timeout 1 vm_compute. reflexivity.`/`Qed.` idiom seen in memory.v, confirmed at both the LT/GT head and SAR tail -- same genuine computational-verification pattern, not junk.

Re-ran the marker grep with line numbers on the next-lowest files to check each hit individually: `alloy_primitives/utils/simulate/mod.v` (3 hits: two `Definition`, one `Lemma`), `instructions/simulate/host/extcodecopy.v` (2 hits: one `Definition`, one `Lemma`), `instructions/simulate/system/keccak256.v` (2 hits: one `Definition`, one `Lemma`), `tests/interpreter.v` (3 hits: three `Definition`), `alloy_primitives/utils/simulate/keccak256.v` (15 hits: `Notation`/`Module`/multiple `Definition`/`Fixpoint`) -- all are genuine translated-semantics definitions with correctness lemmas, no junk or placeholder content.

Read `interpreter/links/runtime_flags.v` in full (399 bytes, the smallest file in the unit, 3 hits): a `RocqOfRustLinkRecord` declaration for `revm_interpreter::interpreter::runtime_flags::RuntimeFlags` (fields `is_static`, `spec_id`) plus one `Definition non_static` -- genuine translated Rust struct/constructor, not a stub.
Checked `tests/call_gas.v` (1524 bytes, smallest 'tests/' file): one `Module` plus 10 `Lemma` declarations -- genuine unit-test-style correctness lemmas about gas accounting.

No file in the 41-file set matched a known exclusion pattern from this session's precedents (Lake/build config, Verso-generated manual, generated data dump, exact duplicate); every low-scoring file was individually read/grepped and confirmed to hold genuine translated Rust/EVM semantics, correctness lemmas, or computational verification goals.
